name: Israel And Palestine
overview: Scripture reveals God's sovereign promise to Abram and his descendants, granting them a specific land from the river of Egypt to the Euphrates as an everlasting covenant (Genesis 12:1; 15:18). This land, described as good and flowing with milk and honey, was to be possessed by the children of Israel as part of God's redemptive plan to deliver them from bondage and establish His people (Exodus 3:8; Joshua 1:2). The Lord affirms His ownership of the land, reminding His people that they are but strangers and sojourners under His authority (Leviticus 25:23), and even as Joshua aged, the task of possessing the land remained a divine mandate (Joshua 13:1).
